list.name: cluster
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.cluster" WITH KEY = "cluster"

list.name: domain
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.protectiondomain.iops.read" WITH KEY = "protection_domain_name" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/

list.name: pool
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.storagepool" WITH KEY = "storage_pool_name" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "protection_domain_name" =~ /^$domain$/

list.label: sds
list.name: sds
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.device" WITH KEY = "sds" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "protection_domain_name" =~ /^$domain$/ AND "storage_pool_name" =~ /^$pool$/

list.name: device
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.device" WITH KEY = "device_name" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "protection_domain_name" =~ /^$domain$/ AND "storage_pool_name" =~ /^$pool$/ AND "sds" =~ /^$sds$/

list.name: devicepath
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.device" WITH KEY = "device_path" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "protection_domain_name" =~ /^$domain$/ AND "storage_pool_name" =~ /^$pool$/ AND "sds" =~ /^$sds$/
